title: Dispatch Run Envelope
description: One supervised harness run as recorded by a dispatch-runner wrapper. Discriminated by `outcome` (completed | refused-pre-spawn | config-fatal | timeout | interrupted) so refusal envelopes validate without over-nullabilizing the completed shape. Every field's trust provenance (wrapper-derived / harness-reported / env-recorded claim) is tabulated in this family's README; non-wrapper-derived fields are untrusted inputs for security decisions. Consumers MUST fail closed on a missing or unknown `envelope_schema`. Paths are opaque strings (no filesystem semantics implied). This schema is tool-validated (not vendor-enforced): it uses the portable core plus the constructs listed and justified in the family README, per the platform structured-output schema policy as amended.

iso-datetime.description: RFC 3339 timestamp. `format` is annotation-only in many validators; the pattern is the enforced floor. The relation ended_at >= started_at is semantic rule SEM-E01 (see semantic-validation.md).

sha256-hex.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 digest (bare, no prefix).

opaque-path.description: Opaque path-like string. Consumers MUST NOT ascribe filesystem semantics; recorded for forensics only.

posture.description: Write-denial posture class, strongest to weakest: OS sandbox > tool deny-rules > none.

group_reap_evidence.description: How process-group reap outcome was established. not_applicable: no reap path (group_reap is not_attempted). membership_verified: outcome from trusted membership probe. kill_dispatched: kill API accepted / process-not-found only (not membership drained). unknown: fail-closed residual. OPTIONAL in this pin revision (not required); when ABSENT, consumers MUST treat as unknown (never membership_verified). Path-emitted by the producer — never inferred from OS alone. Cross-field invariants: SEM-E13..E15.

envelope_schema.description: Exact canonical $id URI of this schema. Consumers MUST reject an envelope whose envelope_schema is missing or unknown (fail-closed; no version negotiation in v0).

producer.description: Stable name of the emitting program (wrapper-derived). Distinct from emitter_version so emitter and contract versions never conflate.

emitter_version.description: Version of the emitting program (wrapper-derived). Not the contract version — that is envelope_schema.

outcome.description: Discriminator for the run's terminal mode. completed: the harness was spawned and exited on its own. refused-pre-spawn: fail-closed posture/fence/evidence refusal — the harness was never spawned. config-fatal: configuration/environment error (may occur before or at spawn). timeout: the run exceeded its timeout and the process group was reaped. interrupted: the wrapper received SIGINT/SIGTERM and reaped the group. See the outcome ↔ runner_exit ↔ nullability table in the family README.

runner_exit.description: The wrapper's own process exit class for this run: 0 ok, 2 unschema'd output, 4 environment/config (incl. all pre-spawn refusals), 5 supervised-harness failure (harness crash, timeout, interrupt, unreaped survivors). Bound to outcome by the conditional blocks below.

harness.description: RESOLVED harness lane id. Null unless the requested selector resolved to a configured lane — never the empty string, and never an unresolved raw selector (that trace lives in harness_requested).

harness_requested.description: The raw lane selector as requested, recorded for traceability regardless of whether it resolved (wrapper-recorded input, honestly labeled: a request, not a resolution). Null only when no selector was supplied.

model_requested.description: Model selector passed through to the harness, or null to inherit the harness default.

cwd.description: Working directory the run was (or would have been) dispatched in. Opaque string.

read_only.description: True when the run was dispatched under the read-only reviewer default (no --write residue accepted).

task_class.description: Task class used for timeout resolution, or null when none was requested.

timeout_s.description: Resolved timeout in seconds. Null only when the run failed before timeout resolution (config-fatal).

digests.description: Wrapper-derived SHA-256 digests of the run inputs. schema_sha256 non-null is the envelope's record that a verdict schema was requested; verdict_schema_sha256 MUST equal it (SEM-E05).

duration_ms.description: Wrapper-measured wall-clock duration in milliseconds (monotonic clock; may differ marginally from the timestamp delta).

harness_exit.description: The harness process's own exit code. Null when the harness was never spawned, or exited via signal without a code (e.g. reaped on timeout).

group_reap.description: Process-group reap outcome. not_attempted: no reap was needed or possible (incl. every pre-spawn path). survivors: at least one group member outlived SIGKILL — non-success semantics, bound to outcome/runner_exit by SEM-E06/SEM-E12 (never with runner_exit 0).

group_reap_evidence.description: Evidence grade for group_reap. Optional this revision; absent ⇒ consumers treat as unknown. See $defs/group_reap_evidence and SEM-E13..E15.

posture_enforced.description: Write-denial mechanism actually applied to a harness that RAN (wrapper-derived from the enforcing flags it appended — never copied from config). "none" on every never-spawned path (refused-pre-spawn and config-fatal, schema-enforced): flags merely constructed into an argv that never executed enforce nothing.

harness_path.description: Resolved executable path of the harness binary (opaque string). Null before resolution.

harness_version.description: Version string probed from the harness executable (harness-reported: it is the binary's own claim). Consumed only in the fail-closed comparison against recorded posture evidence.

harness_pgid.description: Process-group id the harness was spawned into. Null when never spawned.

session_id.description: Harness-reported session identifier. Untrusted for security decisions.

usage.description: Harness-reported token/usage telemetry, schema-agnostic (shape varies per lane). Untrusted for security decisions.

num_turns.description: Harness-reported turn count, when the lane surfaces one.

verdict.description: Schema-agnostic verdict object, exactly as produced by the lane's structured-output mechanism and accepted by the wrapper's independent validation. UNTRUSTED-UNTIL-REVALIDATED: consumers MUST revalidate against the schema bound by verdict_schema_id + verdict_schema_sha256 before acting on it. Never a partial object on reject paths. Tri-state when null: not-requested (digests.schema_sha256 null) | run never produced one (outcome != completed, or refusal) | schema-failed (parse_error non-null). See SEM-E02..E09.

verdict_schema_id.description: Identifier of the requested verdict schema: its canonical $id when it declares one, else "sha256:<hex>" of the schema text. Null iff no verdict schema was requested. Required non-null whenever a verdict was requested (SEM-E04/E05).

verdict_schema_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the requested verdict schema text. Non-null iff digests.schema_sha256 is non-null, and equal to it (SEM-E05). Binds the verdict member to the exact schema it was validated against.

rejected_verdict.description: Forensics only, NON-CONTROL-PLANE: the JSON serialization of a verdict object that the wrapper's independent validation rejected, truncated to the size bound (may therefore be invalid JSON). Pinned as a size-bounded string precisely so it can never be re-promoted to `verdict`. Non-null implies verdict null and parse_error non-null (SEM-E09). HYBRID provenance: wrapper-performed serialization of harness-reported content.

raw_text.description: The lane's original raw output text (harness-reported), preserved as forensic evidence when no verdict was accepted. Null whenever verdict is non-null (SEM-E02) — never both. Size-bounded sensitive surface; emitters MUST truncate to the bound (JSON Schema maxLength counts Unicode code points).

parse_error.description: Wrapper-authored description of why no verdict was accepted. HYBRID provenance: the message is wrapper-derived but may quote harness-reported content verbatim — treat quoted material as untrusted. Size-bounded sensitive surface; emitters MUST truncate to the bound. Null whenever verdict is non-null (SEM-E03).

stderr_tail.description: HYBRID provenance by path: tail of the harness stderr (harness-reported) when a harness ran; the wrapper-authored refusal/fatal message on never-spawned paths. Size-bounded sensitive surface; emitters MUST truncate to the bound.

session_token_present.description: Presence-only boolean: whether a session token variable was set in the wrapper's environment. NOT PROOF of identity or attestation — never token material, never a hash. Env-recorded claim; over-trust is the failure mode this label exists to prevent.

env_identity.description: Typed recorded identity claims from the wrapper's environment. ENV-RECORDED CLAIMS, not proofs, until platform attestation evidence lands as a separate versioned member. Untrusted inputs for security decisions. (Field name retained from the shipped emitter for round-trip compatibility; the shape is the typed recorded-claims block.)
